messages.subject: Reliable way to determine out.format?
parts:
Is there a reliable way to determine the following information that works with each document type knitr supports?

<<>>=
library (knitr)
unlist( opts_knit$get("out.format") )
unlist( opts_chunk$get() )
unlist( opts_current$get() )
unlist( knit_patterns$get() )
@

For this example; knitr w/ Sweave2knitr then knit2pdf works and seems ok, yet using rstudio's 'knit'/'compile' button it doesn't.

Any recommendations?

Thell

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Reliable way to determine out.format?
parts:
The output format is stored in opts_knit$get("out.format"), but this
is not part of the public API, so please do not use it for production
purposes. I'm considering making it into the public API, and it may
end up as a function like knitr::knit_output_format(). This should be
done before knitr 1.6 is released. Thanks!

Regards,
Yihui
